background.ferry: born in {home}, {who.they} poled barges on the fen rivers until the flood year took the boat.
grew up on the ferry at {home}, and can still tell deep water by its colour.
background.tanner: came out of the tan pits at {home}, and the smell went with {who.them} for a year.
worked hides at {home} until {who.they} decided other people's trouble paid better.
background.eel-catcher: set eel traps in the dykes around {home}; patient, and quick with a knife.
born in {home}, where {who.they} caught eels and sold them to people who complained about eels.
background.reed-cutter: cut reed for thatch at {home} from the age of nine.
a reed-cutter's child from {home}, used to cold water and long days.
background.striker: swung the big hammer for the smith at {home} until {who.their} arms were wanted elsewhere.
struck iron at {home}; {who.they} still {who~judges|judge} a blade by its ring.
background.drover: drove cattle from {home} to the market towns and back, in every weather.
walked the drove roads out of {home}, and knows every inn that waters its ale.
background.miller: hauled sacks at the mill in {home} until the miller's debts closed it.
worked the mill at {home}, and learned there that wheels break at the worst time.
background.levy: came home to {home} from a lord's levy with a spear and no pay.
served a season in the levy out of {home}, and did not care for the officers.
background.shepherd: kept sheep on the high ground above {home}; wolves taught {who.them} the rest.
a shepherd from {home}, slow to talk and hard to frighten.
background.carter: drove a cart between {home} and the coast until the road got too dangerous to drive.
carted peat and salt out of {home}; {who.they} {who~knows|know} every bad bridge in the March.
background.peat-digger: cut peat in the black fields of {home}; {who.they} found a bog body once and {who~does|do} not speak of it.
dug peat at {home}, which is hard work for no thanks.
background.novice: left the temple at {home} before taking vows, for reasons {who.they} {who~keeps|keep} to {who.themself}.
a temple novice from {home} who found the quiet life too quiet.
background.poacher: took the lord's deer around {home}, by most accounts, and came to the guild one step ahead of the reeve.
grew up in {home} knowing which woods had keepers and which had none.
background.clerk: kept the tithe rolls at {home}; {who.they} can still add a column faster than anyone in the guild.
a clerk from {home} who wanted to see the places in the ledgers.
